title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Purchase Qualification Standard
content:
**Standard.** A Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan may be bought only for an agreement of a kind the plan covers and a class on the plan's list of classes that has run at least the plan's minimum tenure in calendar months. The covered agreement must be in active status, owe nothing, and have no move-out notice on file. The locked rent may not be below the plan's lowest monthly rent it may lock. Business accounts may pay a plan on invoice where the plan allows invoice payment by a business account.

The kinds, classes, minimum tenure, lowest lockable rent and invoice option are set for each plan.

## Conditions, each of which must hold

| # | Condition | What the records must show for the agreement the plan will cover |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Kind of agreement | A storage unit rental agreement or a parking agreement, as the plan covers |
| 2 | Class | The unit or space class is on the plan's list |
| 3 | Tenure | The agreement has run at least the plan's minimum tenure in calendar months |
| 4 | Status | The agreement is in active status |
| 5 | Balance | The agreement owes nothing |
| 6 | Move-out notice | No move-out notice is on file for the agreement |
| 7 | Locked rent | The rent the plan would lock is not below the plan's lowest lockable rent |

Conditions 4 to 6 are read from the company's records for that same agreement before the purchase — its status, its balance due and its move-out notices — not from the tenant's description of the account and not from another agreement the tenant holds. If any one of conditions 1 to 7 fails, the plan may not be bought for that agreement.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements)

| Agreement | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Active, owes $0.00, no move-out notice, class and kind on the plan's lists, tenure met, rent above the floor | May be bought |
| Same, but owes $0.01 | May not be bought — the agreement does not owe nothing |
| Same, but a move-out notice is on file | May not be bought |
| Same, but the agreement's status is not active | May not be bought |
| Same, but the plan requires 3 calendar months and the agreement has run 2 | May not be bought under that plan |
| Same, but the rent the plan would lock is exactly the plan's lowest lockable rent | May be bought — equal to the floor is not below it |
| Same, but the rent is one cent below the plan's lowest lockable rent | May not be bought |

**Two agreements of one tenant.** A tenant with one storage unit that owes a balance and a second, separate unit that owes nothing is judged agreement by agreement: the balance on the first does not decide whether a plan may be bought for the second.

**Invoice.** A business account may pay the plan on invoice only under a plan that allows it; this option concerns how the prepayment is paid and is not a condition of qualifying.
